meta.name: UI Bundle Free
meta.description: Free sample sheets from a UI mockup bundle (UIBundleFree.zip), unzipped from the repo root. Each file is a themed set of UI mockups (menu panel + icon grid) from a different style pack. Not wired into any game yet. macOS __MACOSX/.DS_Store junk from the zip was discarded.

atlases.note: Casino-themed UI mockup: mixed-size panel + icon grid, not a uniform frame grid.
Generic fantasy UI mockup: menu panel (Play/Settings/Exit) plus a grid of small icon buttons - mixed sizes, not a uniform frame grid.

usage: Each file is a single irregular atlas (panel art + icon grid mixed at different sizes), not a fixed-cell spritesheet. Load with this.load.image(key, basePath + path) and slice the individual icon/panel regions by hand (e.g. this.textures.get(key).add(frameName, 0, x, y, w, h)) or repack with a texture-packer tool before use.
